newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Village no comment on London cinema report.
newsitem.headline: Village no comment on London cinema report.

text.p: Australian cinema and theme park group Village Roadshow Ltd said on Wednesday it would make a comment next week on a report that it was part of a venture to build a US$56 million, 32-screen theatre in London.

The Daily Variety magazine reported on Tuesday that Village along with its Warner Village Cinemas joint venture partner Warner Brothers International Theatres planned to build the complex at London's abandoned Battersea Power Station.
"We might be able to comment on that report in five days time. But I'm sorry I can't say anything now," a Village spokesman said.
Warner Village owns and operates 17 multiplex cinema sites in Britain but aims to have up to 40 sites in operation by the year 2000.
Warner Village is also active in Germany, Portugal and Spain.
